purpose: Shared Russian/English command aliases for the repository integration operator.

interpretation.multiple_aliases: Compose the referenced canonical actions; do not repeat an action just because several synonyms are present.
interpretation.force: Priority/expedite intent only. It never means bypassing required reviews, CI, security checks, or branch protections.
interpretation.push: Publish changes to the intended feature branch or approved target; do not push directly to protected branches.
interpretation.merge: Merge only a reviewed PR after all repository-required gates pass.
interpretation.execute: Start the validated operation; it does not expand repository scope by itself.
interpretation.scope: Use only repositories and branches explicitly included in the request or authorized repository inventory.

force_push_allowed_only_when: A specific non-protected feature branch is named.
The current remote head SHA has been read and an exact expected-head lease is used.
The operation is reviewed for loss of commits and a recoverable backup/ref exists.
No repository policy or required check is bypassed.
safeguards.merge_method: Use a repository-enabled method; prefer squash when enabled and consistent with repository policy.
safeguards.dependency_order: Integrate cross-repository changes in dependency/topological order.
safeguards.audit: Record repository, PR, source/target refs, checks, review state, merge method, commit SHA, and outcome.

agent_identity.note: ChatGPT has no assignable GitHub login. A real GitHub App or service-account identity is required for autonomous API actions; grant least privilege and do not grant ruleset bypass.
